title: Copilot telemetry and coaching - pilot
description: Observed chat tokens by project, source and model, daily Copilot coaching from Chronicle, and telemetry diagnostics. Not billing or complete usage accounting.

options.content:
### Project token usage
Observed tokens from deduplicated **chat spans only**, filtered by project, configured client source, and time. Agent/tool spans are excluded from token sums to avoid overlapping totals. Cache reads are shown separately, not added to input tokens.

These are reported observations, **not billing or guaranteed complete usage**. Missing usage is shown in the tables; unresolved projects remain `unattributed`. Daily Copilot coaching follows; raw telemetry is collapsed below.

Source is configured gateway ingress, not authenticated origin. Historical or unlabelled exports are `unknown` and remain included under All. Coaching panels are independent of this filter.

panels.title: Observed input tokens
panels.description: Sum of reported input tokens on deduplicated chat spans only. Agent/tool spans are excluded. Missing values are not proof of zero usage; this is not billing.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
OTelSpans
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where tostring(Attributes['telemetry.origin']) == 'unverified_client'
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by TraceId, SpanId
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| extend RawSource=tostring(Attributes['telemetry.source'])
| extend TelemetrySource=iff(RawSource in ('vscode', 'desktop'), RawSource, 'unknown')
| where ${source:singlequote} == '*' or TelemetrySource == ${source:singlequote}
| extend ProjectId=tostring(Attributes['project.id'])
| where ${project:singlequote} == '*' or ProjectId == ${project:singlequote}
| where tostring(Attributes['gen_ai.operation.name']) == 'chat'
| extend InputTokens=tolong(Attributes['gen_ai.usage.input_tokens'])
| summarize InputTokens=iff(countif(isnotnull(InputTokens)) > 0, sum(InputTokens), long(null))

panels.title: Observed cache-read tokens
panels.description: Reported cache-read tokens from deduplicated chat spans. Shown separately; never added to input tokens. Missing cache reporting is not treated as zero.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
OTelSpans
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where tostring(Attributes['telemetry.origin']) == 'unverified_client'
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by TraceId, SpanId
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| extend RawSource=tostring(Attributes['telemetry.source'])

| extend ProjectId=tostring(Attributes['project.id'])

panels.title: Last observed span
panels.description: Latest span start time within the selected range, not collector heartbeat or process health. A historical range can intentionally show an old timestamp.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
OTelSpans
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where tostring(Attributes['telemetry.origin']) == 'unverified_client'
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by TraceId, SpanId
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| extend RawSource=tostring(Attributes['telemetry.source'])
| extend TelemetrySource=iff(RawSource in ('vscode', 'desktop'), RawSource, 'unknown')
| where ${source:singlequote} == '*' or TelemetrySource == ${source:singlequote}
| extend ProjectId=tostring(Attributes['project.id'])
| where ${project:singlequote} == '*' or ProjectId == ${project:singlequote}
| summarize LastSpan=max(TimeGenerated)
| project LastSpan=tolong((LastSpan - datetime(1970-01-01)) / 1ms)

panels.title: Observed tokens over time
panels.description: Input, output, and cache-read observations from deduplicated chat spans, bucketed by span start time. Series are not stacked or added together; cache reads may overlap input.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
OTelSpans
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where tostring(Attributes['telemetry.origin']) == 'unverified_client'
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by TraceId, SpanId
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| extend RawSource=tostring(Attributes['telemetry.source'])
| extend TelemetrySource=iff(RawSource in ('vscode', 'desktop'), RawSource, 'unknown')
| where ${source:singlequote} == '*' or TelemetrySource == ${source:singlequote}
| extend ProjectId=tostring(Attributes['project.id'])
| where ${project:singlequote} == '*' or ProjectId == ${project:singlequote}
| where tostring(Attributes['gen_ai.operation.name']) == 'chat'
| extend InputTokens=tolong(Attributes['gen_ai.usage.input_tokens']), OutputTokens=tolong(Attributes['gen_ai.usage.output_tokens']), CacheReadTokens=tolong(Attributes['gen_ai.usage.cache_read.input_tokens'])
| summarize InputTokens=iff(countif(isnotnull(InputTokens)) > 0, sum(InputTokens), long(null)), OutputTokens=iff(countif(isnotnull(OutputTokens)) > 0, sum(OutputTokens), long(null)), CacheReadTokens=iff(countif(isnotnull(CacheReadTokens)) > 0, sum(CacheReadTokens), long(null)) by bin(TimeGenerated, $__interval)
| order by TimeGenerated asc

panels.title: Observed tokens by model
panels.description: Reported chat-span tokens by model for the selected projects. MissingUsage counts chat spans missing input or output; MissingCache counts spans without cache-read reporting. Null totals mean no reported value.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
OTelSpans
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where tostring(Attributes['telemetry.origin']) == 'unverified_client'
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by TraceId, SpanId
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| extend RawSource=tostring(Attributes['telemetry.source'])
| extend TelemetrySource=iff(RawSource in ('vscode', 'desktop'), RawSource, 'unknown')
| where ${source:singlequote} == '*' or TelemetrySource == ${source:singlequote}
| extend ProjectId=tostring(Attributes['project.id'])
| where ${project:singlequote} == '*' or ProjectId == ${project:singlequote}
| where tostring(Attributes['gen_ai.operation.name']) == 'chat'
| extend Model=tostring(Attributes['gen_ai.response.model'])
| extend Model=iff(isempty(Model), '(not reported)', Model)
| extend InputTokens=tolong(Attributes['gen_ai.usage.input_tokens']), OutputTokens=tolong(Attributes['gen_ai.usage.output_tokens']), CacheReadTokens=tolong(Attributes['gen_ai.usage.cache_read.input_tokens'])
| summarize ChatSpans=count(), InputTokens=iff(countif(isnotnull(InputTokens)) > 0, sum(InputTokens), long(null)), OutputTokens=iff(countif(isnotnull(OutputTokens)) > 0, sum(OutputTokens), long(null)), CacheReadTokens=iff(countif(isnotnull(CacheReadTokens)) > 0, sum(CacheReadTokens), long(null)), MissingUsage=countif(isnull(InputTokens) or isnull(OutputTokens)), MissingCache=countif(isnull(CacheReadTokens)) by Model
| order by InputTokens desc

options.content:
### Copilot coaching
Daily `/chronicle tips` and `/chronicle standup` reports from Copilot CLI (VS Code agent sessions included), normalized by the Azure model into short items. Only these derived items are stored here; no prompts, replies, code, or paths. Covers **all projects**; the Project ID filter applies to telemetry panels only.

panels.title: Most repeated tip theme
panels.description: Derived from Copilot CLI /chronicle reports via the Azure model. Covers all projects; the Project ID filter does not apply. Counts tips in the selected time range.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
CopilotInsights_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(90d)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by RunId, Kind, Rank
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where Kind == 'tip'
| summarize Tips=count() by Category
| top 1 by Tips desc
| project Focus=Category

panels.title: Latest tips
panels.description: Derived from Copilot CLI /chronicle reports via the Azure model. Covers all projects; the Project ID filter does not apply.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
let rows = CopilotInsights_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(90d)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by RunId, Kind, Rank
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where Kind == 'tip';
rows
| where RunId == toscalar(rows | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, RunId) | project RunId)
| project Rank, Theme=Category, Tip=Title, Detail, Generated=TimeGenerated
| order by Rank asc

panels.title: Tip themes over time
panels.description: Derived from Copilot CLI /chronicle reports via the Azure model. Covers all projects; the Project ID filter does not apply. Recurring themes are the habits to work on.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
CopilotInsights_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(90d)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by RunId, Kind, Rank
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where Kind == 'tip'
| summarize Tips=count() by bin(TimeGenerated, $__interval), Category
| order by TimeGenerated asc

panels.title: Latest standup
panels.description: Derived from Copilot CLI /chronicle reports via the Azure model. Covers all projects; the Project ID filter does not apply.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
let rows = CopilotInsights_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(90d)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by RunId, Kind, Rank
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where Kind == 'standup';
rows
| where RunId == toscalar(rows | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, RunId) | project RunId)
| extend Order=case(Category == 'completed', 1, Category == 'today', 2, 3)
| order by Order asc, Rank asc
| project Status=Category, Repository, Item=Title, Detail

panels.title: Pilot notes | privacy, accounting and analysis scope

options.content:
### Reading the numbers
Token panels sum only deduplicated **chat spans**. Agent and tool totals are excluded to avoid overlap. Cache-read tokens are separate observations, not an extra amount to add to input. Missing fields are not converted into zero totals; MissingUsage and MissingCache expose incomplete reporting. Transport loss, unsupported clients, subagent overlap, and billing reconciliation remain unverified.

Exact approved local session identities determine project aliases. Direct or unresolved spans remain `unattributed`; project selection cannot repair historical rows. Live two-project acceptance remains pending.

Last observed span is data freshness, not process health. The gateway health endpoint checks local reachability, not Azure. Time filters use span start time (30-day lookback) and coaching run time (90-day lookback).

### Metadata only
VS Code Insiders is configured to send metadata from **all projects** after a window reload, with content and identity capture disabled. The local collector filters traces before persistence/upload and discards logs and aggregate metrics.

No prompts, replies, code, tool payloads, or identity fields are permitted in dashboard storage.

### Daily coaching is separate
**Copilot Daily Coaching** runs `/chronicle tips` and `/chronicle standup` in Copilot CLI at **09:00 local time**. Chronicle analyses session history inside Copilot; only its short reports go to the Azure model, and only validated items (theme, title, detail, repository) are published here. Telemetry arriving here does not trigger coaching. Check `python -m tools.coaching status` for job health.

**Desktop:** metadata capture must remain `NO_CONTENT`. Pseudonymous identity may still reach the local gateway; the collector removes it before its queue and upload. Root/exclusion rules opt workspaces out of project attribution, not out of telemetry collection. `telemetry.source` is the configured client route; legacy/unlabelled records are unknown.
